plan.title: SRC-CRE-045 — Upload Sheet with Good Rows

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the required event title so the create flow can proceed.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is rendered.
Verify that the RFQ product sheet has the expected headers before upload.
Attempt the closest available action to download the sheet template.
Verify that a template file was downloaded.
Upload the available CSV fixture as the closest expressible substitute for the edited three-row template.
Verify that the sheet contains three line items after the upload.
